name: Inmate Kingpin
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve orange long coat, tattoos, gold chains/fist medallion, ledger and armored boots. Replace crown belt buckle and every crown on locks/coat/boot patterns with simple FISTS; no crowns permitted. Review three-carrier chain transfer, sparse cyan backing, stable gold geometry and title.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Inmate Kingpin — Run the Yard.
IDENTITY: exact imposing adult brown-skinned man with gold-tipped dark braids, short black goatee, gold hoop earrings, neck and arm tattoos, long distressed orange prison coat with black inner panels over a weathered white tank, orange trousers, enormous black boots with gold metal straps, many heavy gold chains, fist pendant, gold rings, hanging gold padlocks and a thick handwritten ledger under his left arm. IMPORTANT ART CORRECTION: replace the crown-shaped belt buckle with a bold gold FIST buckle; replace every smaller crown mark on locks, coat patterns and boot details with plain fist emblems. Preserve everything else. No throne or crown.
0–1.2s: full-body low-angle establishment. He closes his ledger with one decisive palm slap and plucks a single square gold padlock off the chain at his belt. He holds it up calmly, then flicks it into the distance with one finger.
1.2–3.2s: camera follows the flying lock, pulling way back to reveal THREE enormous isolated hanging chain loops at staggered distances, each with an unlit charcoal fist charm. No prison, bars, buildings or floor. The small lock snaps onto the first loop; the entire loop becomes brilliant warm gold and its fist charm clenches. The lock immediately rockets from the first loop to the second, then to the third, activating each in a clean accelerating relay. Cyan stays visible through all loop centers and between the separate objects.
3.2–4.8s: on the third click, all THREE giant chain loops pull taut in a synchronized triangular formation around Kingpin. He yanks his outstretched fist down once and the chains SNAP inward, their fist charms meeting above him in one monumental gold-and-ivory impact star. A short contact hold, then three heavy warm-gold shock crescents travel outward and terminate on cyan. The chain relay should feel like commanding an entire invisible crew: small gesture, gigantic consequence. He remains fully visible beneath the impact, never swallowed by effects.
4.8–6s: the immense chains swiftly retract into the smaller real chains on his coat. Camera snap-zooms up from his huge boot to his unbothered face as exact title RUN THE YARD slams below his gold fist pendant. He opens the ledger again, already done with the spectacle.
6–8s: return to readable full-body hero pose, coat settling, ledger held casually. The original gold padlock returns and neatly fastens itself to his belt; he doesn't look down, only lifts one eyebrow. A tiny final chain link arrives late and clicks into place. SFX: heavy ledger slap, accelerating lock whistle, THREE distinct metal locking clicks, mounting huge chain tension, thunderous synchronized chain impact, retracting metallic rush, title slam, tiny final latch click. No voices or music.
